additional_info.body:
Hello Sakari﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
WJv88t
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
WJv88t
Problem Description
: SECC_DC1_MB_Problem_KF12 and Outlet 1 is out of order.
Troubleshooting
:
Remotely: Check if the communication is established correctly and the SECC is correctly working.
On-Site:
Check if the Ethernet cable is properly attached to the switch. It come from +F03-KF12 (J10) output through WD5 cable and it reaches the +F03-XF1:P5
If we cannot check the connectivity, we can test replacing the Ethernet cable.
If it doesn't work then try replacing the KF12 and see if it works.
Check if the 24V are being applied correctly to KF12 coming from the +F03-XD3:18C to the VDC input of the KF12
If there are no 24V being applied to KF12, please check if the XD3 connector is correctly fitted and there are no loose connections
Otherweise please check if FC15 is tripped and having 24V output.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0378413
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

What is your opinion?
Thank you!
Best regards,
